messages:
ria: Quick ask  can we add a "variant confidence" overlay to the per-model cost card? Product wants to avoid changing routing on noisy signal.

oliver: Strong yes. We need a conservative CI band and a clear "sampled vs exact" indicator.

noor: Implementation sketch: keep per-key accumulators at ingest for weighted sums and second moments. For each sampled event include `sample_rate` so aggregator can use w=1/sample_rate and compute sum_wx and sum_wx2. That gives var(sum) = sum(w^2 * var(x)) approx.

ria: Example event (no prompt text):
```
{ ts:1721000000, route_id:"r_web_chat", tenant_id:"cust_7", model_id:"rw-1.3", variant:"int8-a", tokens_out:210, cache_saved_tokens:40, cache_hit:false, sample_rate:0.005 }
```

oliver: Nice. UI rules: hide band if sample_n < 30 and show a fuzzy "low confidence" badge. For sampled rows show a tooltip: "estimate from X% sampled telemetry; 95% CI shown".

noor: Mathematically we can compute approximate 95% CI from aggregated stats. We'll provide `est_sum_tokens` and `ci_lower`/`ci_upper` to the console API. Also include `sample_n` and `effective_n` (sum of weights) so product can gate actions.

mktg-bot: FYI: product wants an exportable CSV for post-mortems that includes sample metadata.

ria: Permissioning: add permission flag `econ.variant_inspect`. Default org-users see aggregated tenant cost only. For privacy/enterprise we can send `model_hash` instead of `model_name` and let tenant supply a mapping in private deployments.

oliver: On ingest-side: aggregator stores per-hour keys: (hour, route, model_hash_or_name, variant_hash_or_name, cache_hit). Columns: sum_w_tokens_out, sum_w_tokens_in, sum_w_cache_saved, sum_w, sum_wx2_tokens_out, sample_count. This keeps rollup small.

noor: Edgecases: multi-layer cache -> include `cache_layer: [edge,regional,global]` or a `cache_provenance` tag. If we can only send combined, add `cache_provenance":"combined"`.

ria: Validation: we should run a daily reconcile job over a 7-day sliding window comparing weighted estimates to full-capture ground truth for selected billing tenants. If delta > 1% alert billing.

ingest-bot: deploybot: schema/telemetry-v3-ci-band pushed to staging at 1721000120; aggregator prototype deployed to staging-shard-3.

oliver: UX microcopy: use "Estimated (sampled)" vs "Exact" toggle. Show small CTA "Request exact sample for date range" that triggers a validation pull (costly).

noor: Perf calc: assume peak 8k rps. At 0.5% sample -> ~3.46M events/day. If we pre-aggregate at ingest into counters instead of storing raw, monthly storage looks okay. We'll simulate 0.1%, 0.5%, 1% curves.

mktg-bot: Product ask: include a "why this matters" micro-blurb in the card that explains cache savings can dominate variant cost.

ria: Action items: (1) noor to PR schema + aggregator API + variance math; (2) oliver to produce console mocks with CI band + permission states; (3) infra to run ingest-cost sim for sample rates and shard sizing; (4) ria to draft RFC and tag billing/product.

ria: tagging @product and @billing for visibility. Will follow up with RFC link.
